mapper.insert: INSERT INTO captcha_challenges (id, purpose, code_hash, attempts, expires_at, consumed_at, client_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{attempts}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{clientIp}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE captcha_challenges SET attempts = attempts + 1, consumed_at = COALESCE(#{invalidatedAt}, consumed_at) WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
